coreMemory.english: v. to tell someone that you are grateful for something
coreMemory.structure: thank someone for something /ˈθæŋk ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈfɔːr ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（因某事感谢某人）；thank someone for doing something /ˈθæŋk ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈfɔːr ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（感谢某人做了某事）；thank someone sincerely /ˈθæŋk ˈsʌmˌwʌn sɪnˈsɪrli/（真诚感谢某人）；thank someone personally /ˈθæŋk ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈpɝːsənəli/（亲自向某人致谢）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ thank you your help → ✅ thank you for your help；❌ thanks you for coming → ✅ thank you for coming / thanks for coming

commonErrors.note: 感谢某人所做的事要用 thank someone for something

commonErrors.right: thank you for coming / thanks for coming
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈθæŋk ˈjuː ˈfɔːr ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈθæŋks ˈfɔːr ˈkʌmɪŋ/
commonErrors.note: thank 是动词；thanks 在固定表达中是名词，不接 you

coreMemory.directSynonym: show gratitude to /ˈʃoʊ ˈɡrætəˌtuːd ˈtuː/（向……表示感激）；express gratitude to /ɪkˈsprɛs ˈɡrætəˌtuːd ˈtuː/（向……表达感激）；give thanks to /ˈɡɪv ˈθæŋks ˈtuː/（向……致谢）；acknowledge /ækˈnɑlɪdʒ/（致谢；承认）；be grateful to /ˈbiː ˈɡreɪtfəl ˈtuː/（感激某人）
coreMemory.example: I want to thank you for your detailed feedback.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 我想感谢你的详细反馈。

meanings.english: to tell someone that you are grateful for something
meanings.example: I thanked her for the careful review.

items.phrase: have good luck to thank for the outcome
items.phonetic: /ˈhæv ˈɡʊd ˈlʌk ˈtuː ˈθæŋk ˈfɔːr ðə ˈaʊtˌkʌm/

items.phrase: thank someone on behalf of everyone

fixedPhrases.example: I thanked Maya for her careful review.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我感谢玛雅的认真审查。

fixedPhrases.example: We thanked him for staying late.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们感谢他留到很晚。

fixedPhrases.example: She sincerely thanked everyone who helped.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她真诚感谢了所有帮助过她的人。

fixedPhrases.example: The director called to thank each volunteer personally.
fixedPhrases.translation: 主任打电话亲自感谢每位志愿者。

fixedPhrases.example: I cannot thank you enough for your patience.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我对你的耐心感激不尽。

fixedPhrases.example: We have the rescue team to thank for the safe outcome.
fixedPhrases.translation: 能平安无事，我们应感谢救援队。

fixedPhrases.example: I hope to thank the nurse in person.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我希望当面感谢那位护士。

fixedPhrases.example: The chair thanked every sponsor in writing after the event.
fixedPhrases.translation: 活动结束后，主席以书面形式感谢了每位赞助者。

fixedPhrases.example: I thanked the hosts on behalf of the group.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我代表小组感谢了主办方。

fixedPhrases.example: The audience warmly thanked the performers.
fixedPhrases.translation: 观众热情地感谢了演员。

fixedPhrases.phrase: you can thank someone for that
fixedPhrases.example: You can thank Nina for the improved schedule.
fixedPhrases.translation: 日程得以改善要归功于尼娜。

fixedPhrases.example: Thank goodness everyone reached home safely.
fixedPhrases.translation: 谢天谢地，大家都平安到家了。

synonyms.difference: 强调通过言语或行动表达谢意，语体比日常动词 thank 更正式
正式明确的致谢表达；宾语是受谢者还是受益事项会决定所用句型
常用于公开或宗教语境；宾语是受谢者还是受益事项会决定所用句型
强调公开承认帮助或贡献；宾语是受谢者还是受益事项会决定所用句型
形容词结构，常接 for；宾语是受谢者还是受益事项会决定所用句型

derivatives.note: 通常用复数形式，如 give thanks/thanks to
指对所得帮助、照顾或好处所持的感激心情。
常与 for 或 that 从句连用

derivatives.chinese: 吃力不讨好的；无人感谢的
derivatives.note: 形容需要付出许多努力却很少得到认可或感谢的工作
句首常表示‘幸好’，修饰动作时也可表示怀着感激之情

confusables.difference: thank 后接人再用 for；appreciate 通常直接接事或 doing

coreMemory.chinese: 改变；变化；更换；换乘；兑换
coreMemory.english: v. to become or make something different；v. to replace one thing with another；v. to exchange money into another currency
coreMemory.structure: change something /tʃeɪndʒ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（改变某事）；change from A to B /tʃeɪndʒ ˈfrʌm ˈtuː/（从 A 变为 B）；change into something /tʃeɪndʒ ˈɪntu ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（变成；换上）；change one's mind /tʃeɪndʒ ˈwʌnz ˈmaɪnd/（改变主意）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ We changed another train in Chicago. → ✅ We changed trains in Chicago.；❌ change my idea → ✅ change my mind

commonErrors.wrong: We changed another train in Chicago.
commonErrors.note: change 作不及物动词表示换乘时用 change trains，不能直接把另一列火车作宾语
表示“改变主意”的固定搭配是 change one's mind

coreMemory.directSynonym: alter /ˈɔːltɚ/（改变）；modify /ˈmɑdəˌfaɪ/（修改；调整）；transform /trænsˈfɔːrm/（彻底改变）；switch /ˈswɪtʃ/（切换；更换）；vary /ˈvɛri/（变化；使不同）
coreMemory.example: A small habit can change your whole day.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 一个小习惯可以改变你的一整天。

meanings.english: to become or make something different
to replace one thing with another
meanings.example: I need to change trains in York.
meanings.translation: 我需要在约克换乘火车。

meanings.english: to exchange money into another currency
meanings.example: Where can I change dollars into euros?
meanings.translation: 我在哪里可以把美元换成欧元？

items.chinese: 把现金兑换成当地货币

coreMemory.chinese: 观看；观察；照看；看守；留意；当心
coreMemory.english: v. to look at someone or something for a period of time；v. to take care of or guard someone or something；v. to be alert to a possible danger or change
coreMemory.structure: watch something /ˈwɑtʃ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（观看某事物）；watch someone do something /ˈwɑtʃ ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（看着某人做完某事）；watch someone doing something /ˈwɑtʃ ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（观察某人正在做某事）；watch for something /ˈwɑtʃ ˈfɔːr ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（留意某事）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ watch to the screen → ✅ watch the screen；❌ watch a picture → ✅ look at a picture

commonErrors.note: watch 是及物动词，直接接观看对象，不加 to
看静态图片通常用 look at；watch 更强调持续观察有运动或变化的事物

coreMemory.directSynonym: observe /əbˈzɝːv/（观察）；view /ˈvjuː/（观看；查看）；monitor /ˈmɑnətɚ/（监测）；supervise /ˈsuːpɚˌvaɪz/（监督；照看）；keep an eye on /ˈkiːp ˈæn ˈaɪ ˈɑn/（留意；照看）
coreMemory.example: Watch the video once without reading the subtitles.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 先不看字幕把视频看一遍。

meanings.english: to look at someone or something for a period of time
meanings.example: We watched the match at home.

meanings.english: to take care of or guard someone or something
meanings.example: Can you watch the children tonight?

meanings.english: to be alert to a possible danger or change
meanings.example: Watch for ice on the road.

items.phrase: watch one's step on wet tiles
items.chinese: 在湿滑瓷砖上小心脚下

fixedPhrases.example: We watched the match at home.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们在家观看了比赛。

fixedPhrases.example: I watched the technician replace the battery.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我看着技术员换了电池。

fixedPhrases.example: She watched the children playing outside.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她看着孩子们在外面玩。

fixedPhrases.example: Watch for ice on the bridge.
fixedPhrases.translation: 小心桥面结冰。

fixedPhrases.example: Watch out! There is a bicycle behind you.
fixedPhrases.translation: 小心！你后面有辆自行车。

fixedPhrases.example: Watch out for misleading fees.
fixedPhrases.translation: 小心误导性费用。

fixedPhrases.example: A nurse watched over him all night.
fixedPhrases.translation: 一名护士整夜守护着他。

fixedPhrases.example: Watch your step on the wet stairs.
fixedPhrases.translation: 在湿滑的楼梯上小心脚下。

fixedPhrases.example: The spokesperson watched her words during the live interview.
fixedPhrases.translation: 发言人在直播采访中谨慎措辞。

fixedPhrases.example: I watched the clock during the final hour.
fixedPhrases.translation: 在最后一小时里我一直留意时间。

fixedPhrases.example: Two guards kept watch at the gate.
fixedPhrases.translation: 两名守卫在门口值守。

fixedPhrases.example: Residents watched the rescue unfold from a distance.
fixedPhrases.translation: 居民们从远处看着救援展开。

synonyms.difference: 强调仔细观看并注意细节；观看时长、观察目的和是否持续监测均不同
较正式，可指影视或资料；观看时长、观察目的和是否持续监测均不同
强调持续检查变化或风险；观看时长、观察目的和是否持续监测均不同
